title: Realization-level extension isomorphism for supplied consecutive constant quotient models
statement: Under the hypotheses of the consecutive constant quotient model extension statement, the lower constant quotient realization of the derived scalar extension of E′ is isomorphic to the lower constant quotient realization of E.

source.place: Tag 09C6, the geometric transport part before stalk detection

proof.text: Apply the geometric reduction theorem to the supplied upper model, then compose its isomorphism with the inverse of the supplied lower model isomorphism.
